lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr12Cu8Ge4 (reduced formula Sr3Cu2Ge) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: each Cu and Ge center has eight Sr neighbors, while each Sr center has four Cu and four Ge neighbors, all at 3.3668 Å. This analysis also finds a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Sr-centered 8-vertex polyhedra and corner-sharing between Cu- and Ge-centered polyhedra.
